title: Director Continuous Improvement
text:
The Continuous Improvement Director’s focus is on continuous improvements across Marketing to ensure workflow visualization and prioritization capabilities to improve alignment, increase efficiencies, minimize cost and deliver results. Developing skills and talent focused on Problem Solving and Lean thinking will be a essential part of this role. The position is responsible for creating and implementing process improvement solutions for plans, platforms, and products. This includes establishing metrics to achieve continuous improvement throughout Marketing. The individual works closely with other teams: Branch Operations, Design Engineering, Information Technology, Sales to develop such strategies.

Position Responsibilities:

* Collaborate with Marketing leadership team to facilitate, build and lead the Daikin Comfort Technologies operating system utilizing continuous improvement / Lean principles.
* Drive change culture and provide leadership to ensure Continuous Improvement program success
* Provide mentorship, coaching, and training to the overall Marketing team and process owners with Lean knowledge and tools. Provide feedback, development plans, and recognition to engage your direct reports

* Apply a systematic process to shift individuals, teams, and business units from the current to the desired state. Encourage others to appreciate Help others understand connections within complex issues.
* Influence and support diverse cross-functional teams to identify process improvement opportunities. Ensure support and buy-in to deliver project success.
* Lead, facilitate, and support Actions to drive improvements across Marketing Communications, Experience, Product, and Operations organizations to enable us to reach our growth and productivity metrics.
* Relationship Management & Leadership
* Build talent through a learning environment, helping team members realize their potential

* Establish and foster an environment of Continuous Marketing Process Improvement

* Serve as a key member of the Marketing Operations team and help to execute an aggressive growth strategy which includes significant change management for the development and implementation of Daikin Comfort Technologies Digital Product Development processes and tools.
* Support the vision and strategy that drives continuous improvement in terms of cost reduction (CIP), productivity gains, and best practices to ensure consistent product quality and delivery across all functions and teams.
* Ensure all improvement initiatives support all elements of the organization inclusive of the customer experience and front/back-office operations.
* Provide executive oversight for all Kaizen, Continuous Improvement, and CIP projects.
* Establish and implement a process for standard communication of continuous improvement initiatives across the organization and perform periodic audits to ensure the process is consistent.
* Coordinate and lead meetings for the purpose of selecting improvement projects, report progress on current projects, and maintain standardization of processes.

Nature & scope:

* Develops and implements strategic plans and objectives for the department/sub-function in an effective and innovative fashion.
* Understands the business and can put together comprehensive department solutions.
* Works with other leaders to establish strategic plans and works towards achieving them.
* Provides leadership and direction to managers in their respective division/department.

* Sees department staffing needs (e.g., interviewing, hiring, new hire and ongoing training, annual evaluations, etc.)

* Participates in budget development and monitoring of expenses.

* Level of signing authority established by company policy/guidelines.

Knowledge & Skills:

* Track record of successful project management and team leadership experience.

* Strong knowledge of quality and design engineering, manufacturing, specifications, testing, and inspections.

* Superior interpersonal & communication skills with a unique ability to influence people, articulate ideas, and lead highly productive technical teams.

* Executive presence and demonstrated leadership characteristics of self-motivation, confidence, influence, integrity, and professional savvy.

* Ability to quantify results, lead change, and interface with all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated proficiency in the MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel), MS Project, Visio, etc.

Competencies:

Experience:

* 10 or more years of process/quality improvement experience
* Strong business management skills and process/quality improvement experience

Education/Certification:

* A degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field from a four-year college or university is required. An advanced degree is highly preferred.

People Management:

* Yes

Physical Requirements / Work Environment:

* Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations

Reports To:

* Director, Marketing Operations
